mentions.name: Fudge Design Search
mentions.description: A Prolog-backed design search engine that lets designers and agents query structured design knowledge from real websites. It surfaces concrete inspiration such as fonts, colors, layouts, screenshots, and patterns, powered by data from Font of Web, to help users make better design decisions.
mentions.problem: Designers lack a way to query concrete, structured design knowledge from real websites to inform better design decisions.
mentions.audience: Designers (and AI agents) seeking concrete design inspiration from real websites
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building https://design.withfudge.com, a Prolog-backed design search engine that lets designers/agents query structured design knowledge from real websites.
